title: Highly privileged delegated permission granted for all users
description: Detects a successful Microsoft Entra delegated permission grant that combines the high-privilege RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory scope with AllPrincipals consent for all users.

hypothesis.summary: An adversary or unauthorized administrator may grant an application tenant-wide role-management authority to establish persistence or escalate privileges.
hypothesis.rationale: Microsoft classifies highly privileged delegated permissions granted for all users as high risk, and its Sentinel content identifies RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory because it can manage directory role assignments; approved application onboarding can produce the same event.
hypothesis.detection_goal: Identify successful delegated grants containing both RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory and AllPrincipals while leaving ordinary delegated scopes, per-user consent and application-role grants unmatched.

triage.summary: Identify the target service principal, permission grant and initiator, then confirm whether tenant-wide role-management access was explicitly approved.
steps: Review the initiating user or application, source IP, target service principal, correlation identifier and all modified properties.
Confirm the application owner, consent workflow, business purpose and approval for RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory with AllPrincipals consent.
Inspect subsequent role assignments, credentials, owners and sign-ins associated with the application; revoke the grant and contain the initiator if unauthorized.
false_positives: Explicitly approved tenant-wide onboarding or maintenance of an identity-governance application requiring directory role management

validation.expected_outcome: Match only successful tenant-wide delegated grants containing the selected high-privilege scope; do not match failures, per-user consent, other scopes or application-role grants.
